h2: NDT training near Groton: submarine-industry courses, Electric Boat inspection roles, trainee jobs and online study compared

NDT training near Groton: submarine-industry courses, Electric Boat inspection roles, trainee jobs and online study compared

Groton's NDT labour market revolves around submarine construction, and that shows in what a near-me search turns up. In the public catalogues we checked, no college in southeastern Connecticut lists an NDT certificate or degree. What the region does have is a supplier training network built for the submarine programme, senior inspection jobs at the shipyard with Navy-specific qualifications, trainee routes with inspection companies, and online theory with the practical done at an employer.

Who offers NDT training around Groton?

  • The submarine supplier training network. SENEDIA's submarine workforce site lists courses that are free to employees of supplier companies. In Groton itself, the Three Rivers campus of Connecticut State Community College covers machining, planning, shipfitting and welding, not NDT. Across the Rhode Island line, the Westerly Education Center lists a radiography testing course, and New England Institute of Technology in Warwick lists magnetic testing. These are single-method courses for people a supplier already employs.
  • Electric Boat inspection roles. A 2026 General Dynamics Electric Boat posting for an NDT Examiner in Groton asked for current or past RT or UT Level III certification, or at least five years as a Level II, and qualification as a NAVSEA 250-1500-1 examiner in RT, UT, MT, PT and VT within nine months of hire, with familiarity with T9074-AS-GIB-010/271 preferred. That is a senior job built on years of field work, not a way in.
  • Trainee jobs with inspection companies. Firms that support the Thames River shipyards, marine fabricators and power-plant outages along the shoreline take on assistants who log supervised hours toward Level I and Level II. Defense work usually brings citizenship and site-access requirements.
  • Full programmes further away. The New Hampshire community college certificate nearest to New England's shipyards, at Great Bay in Portsmouth, stopped admitting students in fall 2023. The nearest open full-time NDT programmes we could verify are in Pennsylvania, at the Community College of Philadelphia and Penn College in Williamsport.

Which route fits you?

Your situationRealistic route from GrotonWhat to check
Supplier employee new to NDTA network course if your employer sponsors it, plus online method theoryOne course covers one method; Level II needs more hours
No NDT job yetA trainee role with an inspection company, with online theory alongsideCitizenship and site-access requirements
Level II aiming at shipyard examiner workYears of documented experience, Level III preparation, then examiner qualification at the employerNAVSEA examiner qualification is separate from SNT-TC-1A certification
Supplier certifying its own inspectorsTraining delivered at your plant with Level III examinations under your written practiceWhatever extra the shipyard's purchase order flows down to you

Questions to ask any NDT training provider near Groton

  • Hours and acceptance. Does the record show hours per method in line with SNT-TC-1A, and will a NAVSEA-based employer programme accept it? Ask the employer's Level III before you enrol, and check targets with the SNT-TC-1A eligibility checker.
  • The practical. Who sets and grades it, and does it use welds and parts like the ones submarine suppliers make?
  • Certification. A training course issues a record. Your employer certifies you under its written practice, or ASNT certifies after its central exams.
  • Level III access. Is there a Level III you can question during the course, not only at the end?
  • Clearance and access. If the job is inside a defense yard, ask the employer which background checks apply before you invest in training.

Where Atlantis fits for Groton candidates and employers

Atlantis NDT has no classroom in Connecticut. Method theory is online, self-paced and open from the day you enrol, with an ASNT NDT Level III answering technical questions. You rehearse in the Practical NDT simulator, and the hands-on practical and practical exam take place at your employer, on its equipment, under a written practice built on ASNT SNT-TC-1A; the employer certifies. NAVSEA examiner qualification is granted under the shipyard's or supplier's own programme, never by a training course. For the methods submarine work leans on, see ultrasonic testing, radiographic testing theory and magnetic particle testing, at NDT Level 2 or, for experienced technicians, ASNT Level III preparation.

Suppliers in the submarine chain can have training delivered at their own facility and a Level III set up or revise the written practice: see SNT-TC-1A training programme set-up. Nearby pages: NDT training in East Hartford, NDT training in Providence and the Connecticut training page.
